title: Weak Log-Majorization for Negative Lim-Pálfia Power Means
summary: For $0 \le α\le 1$ and $-1 \le r < 0$, let $\#_{r,α}$ denote the weighted Kubo-Ando power mean of order $r$ and weight $α$. Ando proved that, for every unitarily invariant norm, $\| A \ \#_{r,α}\ B \| \le \| A \|\ \#_{r,α}\ \| B \|$. We show that this inequality remains valid also for the Schatten $q$-quasi-norms with $0 < q < 1$. More generally, our main result resolves a problem recently posed by Hiai and Lim in the stronger form of weak log-majorization for multivariable Lim-Pálfia power means of negative order.
